# Museon CLI task guide (3.5.0)

Museon CLI runs MuseOn's social-media operations from an Agent: UGC Campaigns (set up, recruit, approve, contract, daily tasks, content review, counting, client reports), content tracking Campaigns, analytics boards, social accounts and publishing, AI image posts, research and the organization. Find the task below, then run its commands in order. Every command prints one JSON envelope; reads change nothing; a write that reaches someone outside the organization or cannot be undone needs --yes, which only the user may give.

The same guide runs locally: `museoncli guide`, `museoncli guide <task-id>`, `museoncli guide --search <words>`. `museoncli schema <command>` gives one command's full inputs and outputs.

## 0. Start here

Sign in, choose the organization, find a command, keep the CLI and its Skills current. Read the topics on ids and on the confirmation rule before your first write.

See: `ids`, `confirmation`, `organizations`, `which-one`

### Sign in

`museoncli guide login` · when: log in; login; sign in; authenticate; missing_auth; unauthorized; 登录; 授权; 认证

1. `museoncli auth start` (write): Show the user verification_uri_complete; they approve in the browser.
2. `museoncli auth finish --wait` (write): --wait polls until approved (five minutes by default).
3. `museoncli auth status` (read)
4. `museoncli auth logout` (write): Only when the user asks to sign out.

### Choose the organization to act in

`museoncli guide choose-organization` · when: organization; switch organization; select org; missing_organization; which org; 组织; 切换组织; 选组织

1. `museoncli whoami` (read): The organizations this login can act in.
2. `museoncli org list` (read)
3. `museoncli org select --id <organization-id>` (write): Every later command acts there; --organization-id overrides it for one call.
4. `museoncli org current` (read)

See: `organizations`

### Find the command for a job

`museoncli guide find-a-command` · when: which command; how do I; find command; help; schema; 用什么命令; 怎么做; 命令

1. `museoncli guide [<task-id>] [--search <words>]` (read): No argument: chapters and tasks; a task id: its steps; --search: tasks and commands for the user's words.
2. `museoncli schema [<command>] [--compact] [--search <words>]` (read): schema <command> for one command's inputs; --compact --search <words> for a short ranked list.

See: `which-one`, `renamed`

### Check the version, upgrade, install the Skills

`museoncli guide keep-cli-current` · when: version; upgrade; update cli; install skills; setup; 版本; 升级; 安装技能

1. `museoncli version` (read): update_status and upgrade_command say whether and how to upgrade.
2. `museoncli upgrade` (write): Only when the user agrees; a uv tool install upgrades itself.
3. `museoncli setup --agent <codex|claude-code|cursor|all>` (write): Installs the bundled Agent Skills; the host Agent then needs a restart.

## 1. Run a UGC Campaign

A UGC Campaign in the order the work happens: create and set it up, recruit, approve applications, contract, run the day's tasks and messages, review content, decide what counts, report to the client and read settlement. The Campaign itself (create, launch, settings) is `campaign`; the work with its creators is `ugc`. Both take the Campaign id from `campaign +list` as --campaign-id.

See: `ids`, `creator-ids`, `confirmation`, `safe-writes`, `organizations`

### Find a Campaign and its id

`museoncli guide find-campaign` · when: find campaign; campaign id; list campaigns; which campaign; 找活动; 活动列表; campaign 列表

1. `museoncli campaign +list` (read): Both kinds, own and shared-in; --type ugc|tracking, --status, --search narrow it. Its id is every --campaign-id.
2. `museoncli campaign +get --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): One Campaign's header (type, status, start day) and tracking record.

### Create and set up a UGC Campaign

`museoncli guide ugc-create-campaign` · when: create campaign; new campaign; set up campaign; campaign setup; launch campaign; 新建活动; 创建活动; 活动设置; 上线活动

Dry-run each write, show the user, then write. A UGC Campaign can be created only in the operating team's organization.

1. `museoncli campaign +create --name <name>` (write): --type ugc; data.campaign.id is the new --campaign-id. Rerun an unknown outcome with the returned idempotency key.
2. `museoncli campaign settings +update --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write): Approval and join mode, budget cap, platforms, languages, rules; only the fields passed change.
3. `museoncli campaign staff +set --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write): PMs (--manager-user-id); user ids from organization member +list.
4. `museoncli ugc delivery-target +create --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write): A target's dates are its own window; they never move the Campaign's start day.
5. `museoncli ugc contract-template +set --campaign-id <campaign-id> --source default` (write): --source default or custom; the dry run returns the filled preview.
6. `museoncli ugc payscale +create --campaign-id <campaign-id> --name <name>` (write): The default payscale exists already; add custom ones only when creators are paid differently.
7. `museoncli ugc pay-rate +create --campaign-id <campaign-id> --payscale-id <payscale-id> --kind anything-else --rate-json <rate-json>` (write): A video-content rate needs a description; lifetime-views needs min_creator_views.
8. `museoncli ugc discord-server +initialize --campaign-id <campaign-id> --guild-id <guild-id>` (write, needs --yes): Builds onboarding channels and roles in a server the MuseOn bot is already in.
9. `museoncli ugc brief +create --campaign-id <campaign-id> --title <title> --content <content>` (write): Or link library Formats with ugc brief +link (task ugc-formats).
10. `museoncli campaign setup +get --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Read everything back; sections you may not read are listed under unavailable.
11. `museoncli campaign +launch --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write, needs --yes): Dry run first: launchability.ok and reasons; then run it with --expected-status draft.

See: `ugc-formats`, `ugc-recruit`

### Read how a Campaign is configured

`museoncli guide ugc-read-setup` · when: campaign settings; budget; approval mode; contract template; payscale; staff; discord server; dm rules; 活动配置; 预算; 价格; 合同模板; 设置页

1. `museoncli campaign setup +get --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Everything the setup page reads; --section narrows it.
2. `museoncli campaign settings +get --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Type, status, settings, product, readiness, briefs.
3. `museoncli campaign staff +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)
4. `museoncli ugc delivery-target +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)
5. `museoncli ugc payscale +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)
6. `museoncli ugc contract-template +get --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)
7. `museoncli ugc discord-server +get --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)
8. `museoncli ugc dm-rule +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)
9. `museoncli ugc dm-automation +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)

### Change a Campaign's settings, team, targets, payscales or Discord

`museoncli guide ugc-change-setup` · when: change settings; edit campaign; budget cap; change payscale; pay rate; delivery target; discord; 修改设置; 改预算; 改价格; 目标

1. `museoncli campaign settings +update --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write): Writes the whole settings object back with only your fields changed; brand editors may not change the team's settings.
2. `museoncli campaign staff +set --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write): The PMs passed replace the current ones; --no-managers removes them all.
3. `museoncli ugc delivery-target +update --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <delivery-target-id>` (write): 'none' clears a figure or date.
4. `museoncli ugc delivery-target +delete --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <delivery-target-id>` (destructive, needs --yes)
5. `museoncli ugc payscale +update --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <payscale-id>` (write)
6. `museoncli ugc payscale +delete --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <payscale-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): Only a payscale nobody is on.
7. `museoncli ugc pay-rate +update --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <pay-rate-id> --rate-json <rate-json>` (write): The fields in --rate-json change; the rate's kind never does.
8. `museoncli ugc pay-rate +delete --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <pay-rate-id>` (destructive, needs --yes)
9. `museoncli ugc contract-template +set --campaign-id <campaign-id> --source default` (write)
10. `museoncli ugc discord-server +set --campaign-id <campaign-id> --guild-id <guild-id>` (write): An existing server layout: --guild-id plus the welcome, help and review channels.
11. `museoncli ugc discord-server +remove --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): Channels and roles stay in Discord.

### Launch, pause, resume, end, archive or rename a Campaign

`museoncli guide ugc-lifecycle` · when: launch; pause campaign; resume campaign; end campaign; complete; archive; restore; rename; 暂停活动; 结束活动; 归档; 恢复; 改名

1. `museoncli campaign +launch --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write, needs --yes): Draft → active; a UGC one opens its apply link.
2. `museoncli campaign +pause --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write)
3. `museoncli campaign +resume --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write)
4. `museoncli campaign +complete --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): Cannot reopen; creators' accounts are released.
5. `museoncli campaign +archive --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): Draft or completed only; +restore brings it back.
6. `museoncli campaign +restore --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write): Back to the status it was archived from.
7. `museoncli campaign +rename --campaign-id <campaign-id> --name <name>` (write)

### Write and link Formats (脚本, brief)

`museoncli guide ugc-formats` · when: format; brief; script; 脚本; brief library; 格式; 写脚本; 脚本库; link brief

In commands the UGC Format is `brief`. Editing a library Format reaches every Campaign that uses it; tell the user which before they confirm.

1. `museoncli ugc brief-library +list` (read): The organization's library; --status archived shows archived ones.
2. `museoncli ugc brief-library +get --id <brief-library-id>` (read): Current version, the editable document, which Campaigns use it.
3. `museoncli ugc brief-library +create --title <title> --content <content>` (write): A library Format, used by no Campaign until linked.
4. `museoncli ugc brief-library +update --id <brief-library-id> --expected-version 1` (write): A new version; pass --expected-version from your read.
5. `museoncli ugc brief-library +copy --id <brief-library-id>` (write)
6. `museoncli ugc brief-library +archive --id <brief-library-id> --expected-version 1` (destructive, needs --yes): No restore exists.
7. `museoncli ugc brief +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): The Formats one Campaign links.
8. `museoncli ugc brief +get --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <brief-id>` (read)
9. `museoncli ugc brief +create --campaign-id <campaign-id> --title <title> --content <content>` (write): Writes a Format inside the Campaign, linked at once; optional --persona-id.
10. `museoncli ugc brief +link --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <brief-id>` (write): Use a library Format here; --replaces swaps out one already linked.
11. `museoncli ugc brief +copy --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <brief-id>` (write): Copy a Format version into the Campaign for another persona.
12. `museoncli ugc brief +update --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <brief-id> --expected-version 1` (write): Edits the Campaign's Format as a new version; ask whether to --notify creators working on it.
13. `museoncli ugc brief +upload-media --campaign-id <campaign-id> --file <file>` (write): Upload a reference file, then add it to --references-json of +update.
14. `museoncli ugc brief +unlink --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <brief-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): The Format stays in the library.

### Manage UGC personas (creator types)

`museoncli guide ugc-personas` · when: persona; creator type; 人设; 达人类型; persona list

1. `museoncli ugc persona +list` (read): Not ai-slideshow personas.
2. `museoncli ugc persona +create --title <title>` (write): Titles are unique.
3. `museoncli ugc persona +update --id <persona-id>` (write)
4. `museoncli ugc persona +delete --id <persona-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): Only one nothing names any more.
5. `museoncli ugc enrollment +set-persona --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <ids> --persona-id <persona-id>` (write): Give enrollments a persona (up to 200, all or nothing).

### Assign Formats to creators and link videos to Formats

`museoncli guide ugc-assign-formats` · when: assign brief; assignment; who owes a video; brief progress; creative without brief; 分配脚本; 派单; 进度; 没有脚本的视频

1. `museoncli ugc enrollment +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): --status participating: the enrollment ids to assign.
2. `museoncli ugc brief +progress --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Raw counts per brief and assignment; report them, never judge who owes a video.
3. `museoncli ugc assignment +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): The Operations tab's assignments and what is due.
4. `museoncli ugc assignment +create --campaign-id <campaign-id> --brief-id <brief-id> --enrollment-id <enrollment-id>` (write): One brief to one or more enrollments, with video limit, due time, note, priority.
5. `museoncli ugc assignment +update-terms --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <assignment-id>` (write): Saving sends the creator one updated brief.
6. `museoncli ugc assignment +withdraw --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <assignment-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): The creator no longer has the brief.
7. `museoncli ugc creative +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): --brief-id none: videos that cite no Format yet.
8. `museoncli ugc creative +set-brief --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <creative-id> --brief-id <brief-id>` (write): A video delivered against an assignment keeps that assignment's brief.
9. `museoncli ugc creative +apply-default-briefs --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write): Links each brief-less video whose creator has exactly one live assignment.

### Recruit creators (links, invitations, Discord, Comment-to-DM)

`museoncli guide ugc-recruit` · when: recruit; recruitment link; sign-up link; invite; invitation; apply link; comment to dm; dm rule; 招募; 招募链接; 邀请; 报名链接; 评论私信

1. `museoncli ugc recruit-link +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): The discover link comes back as discovery.
2. `museoncli ugc recruit-link +create --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write): An invite link with its own code, roster group, payscale and approval rule, or --kind discover.
3. `museoncli ugc recruit-link +update --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <recruit-link-id>` (write): Settings not passed keep their value.
4. `museoncli ugc recruit-link +revoke --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <recruit-link-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): Stops working at once.
5. `museoncli ugc invitation +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)
6. `museoncli ugc invitation +create --campaign-id <campaign-id> --email <email>` (destructive, needs --yes): MuseOn emails the creator; the preview flags an open invitation to the same address: resend that one instead.
7. `museoncli ugc invitation +resend --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <invitation-id>` (destructive, needs --yes)
8. `museoncli ugc invitation +revoke --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <invitation-id>` (destructive, needs --yes)
9. `museoncli ugc discord-server +get --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Recruits join through the Campaign's Discord server.
10. `museoncli ugc dm-rule +create --campaign-id <campaign-id> --dm-message <dm-message> --button-title <button-title> --destination-url <destination-url>` (write, needs --yes): One open rule per Campaign; an active rule DMs commenters.
11. `museoncli ugc dm-rule +update --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <dm-rule-id>` (write, needs --yes): --status paused stops it, active resumes it, archived ends it.

### Approve or reject applications and onboard creators

`museoncli guide ugc-approve-applications` · when: approve application; reject application; pending creators; admit; onboarding; trial; 审批; 审批报名; 批准; 审核报名; 通过报名; 拒绝报名; 入驻; 试用

Applications wait in the onboarding queue. The task's own approve/reject and the enrollment commands have the same effect.

1. `museoncli ugc task +list` (read): --queue onboarding --actor operator: what waits on the team.
2. `museoncli ugc enrollment +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): --status pending: the applications.
3. `museoncli ugc task +run-action --id <task-id> --action <action>` (destructive, needs --yes): --action approve|reject from the review task; --fields-json {"payscale_id": ...} approves on another payscale.
4. `museoncli ugc enrollment +approve --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <enrollment-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): The direct route: the creator is told and gets the contract.
5. `museoncli ugc enrollment +reject --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <enrollment-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): --note is written to the creator; --ban also bans them. No command reopens it: the creator reapplies.
6. `museoncli ugc enrollment +admit --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <enrollment-id> --note <note>` (write): Admit an onboarding creator by hand (only a signed contract is required); --note records why.
7. `museoncli ugc enrollment +set-persona --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <ids> --persona-id <persona-id>` (write)
8. `museoncli ugc enrollment +set-payscale --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <enrollment-id> --payscale-id <payscale-id>` (write): Compare-and-set on the enrollment's updated_at.
9. `museoncli ugc enrollment +graduate-trial --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <enrollment-id>` (write): Refused while the trial lists graduate blockers.

### Send, check or resend a creator's contract

`museoncli guide ugc-contract` · when: contract; sign; not signed; resend contract; terminate contract; 合同; 签约; 没签; 重发合同

1. `museoncli ugc contract-template +get --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): The Campaign's template and signing parties.
2. `museoncli ugc enrollment +get-contract --enrollment-id <enrollment-id>` (read): One enrollment's contract: draft, sent, signed or terminated.
3. `museoncli ugc task +run-action --id <task-id> --action <action>` (destructive, needs --yes): A contract task's send / mark-signed / terminate.
4. `museoncli ugc message +resend-card --enrollment-id <enrollment-id> --kind contract-card` (destructive, needs --yes): --kind contract-card; the preview lists earlier deliveries.
5. `museoncli ugc enrollment +nudge --id <enrollment-id> --check cant-track` (destructive, needs --yes): --check not-signed reminds the creator in Discord (once a day).

### Pause, resume or remove creators

`museoncli guide ugc-manage-roster` · when: pause creator; resume creator; remove creator; kick; roster; 暂停达人; 恢复达人; 移除达人; 踢出

1. `museoncli ugc enrollment +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)
2. `museoncli ugc enrollment +pause --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <enrollment-id>` (write): Their posts are not collected or settled until resumed.
3. `museoncli ugc enrollment +resume --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <enrollment-id>` (write)
4. `museoncli ugc enrollment +remove --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <ids>` (destructive, needs --yes): Up to 1000 (repeat --id), compare-and-set on each.

### Work through today's tasks

`museoncli guide ugc-daily-tasks` · when: tasks; todo; what needs doing; task queue; claim task; today; 任务; 待办; 今天做什么; 认领

1. `museoncli ugc task-summary +get` (read): Open counts per queue, what waits on you versus others.
2. `museoncli ugc task +list` (read): --queue media|onboarding|creators|posts|viral|invites|client-reports|all --actor operator.
3. `museoncli ugc task +get --id <task-id>` (read): Its actions, context and history; actions are what +run-action accepts.
4. `museoncli ugc task +claim --id <task-id>` (write): So teammates see you are on it.
5. `museoncli ugc task +run-action --id <task-id> --action <action>` (destructive, needs --yes): Press one of the task's own buttons; inputs other than --comments go in --fields-json.
6. `museoncli ugc task +comment --id <task-id> --body <body>` (write): The team sees it; the creator does not.
7. `museoncli ugc task +set-due --id <task-id> --due-at 2026-10-01T09:00:00+08:00` (write): --due-at none clears it; compare-and-set on updated_at.
8. `museoncli ugc task +set-assignees --id <task-id> --assignee-user-id <assignee-user-id>` (write): At most 20 members; --unassign clears.
9. `museoncli ugc task +defer-reminder --id <task-id>` (write): 30 minutes the first time a day; later ones need --remind-at and --reason.
10. `museoncli ugc task +release --id <task-id>` (write)

### Read and send messages to a creator

`museoncli guide ugc-message-creator` · when: message creator; dm creator; conversation; reply to creator; send message; retry message; 私信达人; 发消息; 回复达人; 聊天记录

1. `museoncli ugc message +list --enrollment-id <enrollment-id>` (read): The conversation with one enrolled creator, newest first.
2. `museoncli ugc message +send --body <body> --enrollment-id <enrollment-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): --enrollment-id: their project page; --campaign-id with --creative-id: about one video, pushed to Discord. Keep the returned idempotency_key for a retry.
3. `museoncli ugc message +retry --enrollment-id <enrollment-id> --id <message-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): --id is the failed delivery's intent_id from the message ledger.
4. `museoncli ugc message +resend-card --enrollment-id <enrollment-id> --kind contract-card` (destructive, needs --yes): --kind contract-card|onboarding-card.

### Nudge creators who are stuck (not signed, not set up, quiet)

`museoncli guide ugc-nudge-creators` · when: nudge; remind creators; quiet creators; not set up; creator checks; auto nudge; 催; 提醒达人; 催更; 自动提醒

1. `museoncli ugc creator-check +get --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Creators per check.
2. `museoncli ugc creator-check +list --campaign-id <campaign-id> --kind cant-track` (read): --kind cant-track|not-set-up|not-in-discord|quiet|not-healthy.
3. `museoncli ugc enrollment +nudge --id <enrollment-id> --check cant-track` (destructive, needs --yes): One creator, one check, once a day; the preview says whether the check holds.
4. `museoncli ugc enrollment +bulk-nudge --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): Everyone a check holds for, skipping those nudged today.
5. `museoncli ugc auto-nudge +get --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)
6. `museoncli ugc auto-nudge +update --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write, needs --yes): Which checks nudge automatically, which days, at what local time; --off stops them.

### Broadcast to many creators on Discord

`museoncli guide ugc-broadcast` · when: broadcast; announce; message all creators; 群发; 广播; 通知所有达人

1. `museoncli ugc broadcast +audience --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Who can be reached now: private channels, DMs, public channels, per persona.
2. `museoncli ugc broadcast +create --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write): A draft with its targets; the dry run shows who it would reach.
3. `museoncli ugc broadcast +update --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <broadcast-id>` (write): Only a draft; +unschedule a scheduled one first.
4. `museoncli ugc broadcast +send --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <broadcast-id>` (write, needs --yes): Recipients are fixed now.
5. `museoncli ugc broadcast +schedule --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <broadcast-id> --at 2026-10-01T09:00:00+08:00` (write, needs --yes): Sent within a minute of --at; content locks.
6. `museoncli ugc broadcast +unschedule --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <broadcast-id>` (write)
7. `museoncli ugc broadcast +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)
8. `museoncli ugc broadcast +get --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <broadcast-id>` (read): Every delivery's outcome.
9. `museoncli ugc broadcast +retry --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <broadcast-id>` (write, needs --yes): Failed deliveries only.
10. `museoncli ugc broadcast +withdraw --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <broadcast-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): Deletes sent messages from Discord; cannot be undone.
11. `museoncli ugc broadcast +discard --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <broadcast-id>` (destructive, needs --yes)

### Set the team's reminders and digests

`museoncli guide ugc-team-reminders` · when: reminders; digest; feishu reminder; delegate reminders; 提醒; 日报提醒; 飞书提醒; 代理提醒

1. `museoncli ugc reminder +get --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): The Campaign's own policy, the organization's it inherits, the effective one.
2. `museoncli ugc reminder +update --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write): inherit falls back to the organization; none empties a list.
3. `museoncli ugc reminder +test --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write, needs --yes): Sends only you what the group would get now. MuseOn staff only.
4. `museoncli ugc reminder +subscribe --campaign-id <campaign-id> --subscribed` (write): Your own DM list of this Campaign's tasks at each digest.
5. `museoncli ugc reminder-delegation +create --campaign-id <campaign-id> --user-id <user-id> --delegate-user-id <delegate-user-id> --starts-at 2026-10-01T09:00:00+08:00 --ends-at 2026-10-01T09:00:00+08:00` (write): Someone's reminders go to a colleague while they are away; no access moves.
6. `museoncli ugc reminder-delegation +cancel --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <reminder-delegation-id>` (write, needs --yes)

### Review creators' videos and give feedback

`museoncli guide ugc-review-content` · when: review video; content review; approve video; reject video; feedback; 审核视频; 内容审核; 过审; 打回; 反馈

1. `museoncli ugc task +list` (read): --queue media: the videos waiting for review.
2. `museoncli campaign video +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): --status review: the Content tab's queue.
3. `museoncli campaign video +get --campaign-id <campaign-id> --content-id <content-id>` (read): One post's detail, daily metrics or insights.
4. `museoncli ugc creative +review --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <creative-id> --decision approve` (destructive, needs --yes): --decision approve|reject; a rejection sends --note and reopens the assignment.
5. `museoncli ugc task +run-action --id <task-id> --action <action>` (destructive, needs --yes): Or press the review task's approve/reject (--comments go to the creator).
6. `museoncli ugc feedback-thread +create --campaign-id <campaign-id> --creative-id <creative-id> --body <body>` (destructive, needs --yes): At --time-ms into the video; the creator reads it in Discord.
7. `museoncli ugc feedback-thread +reply --campaign-id <campaign-id> --creative-id <creative-id> --id <feedback-thread-id> --body <body>` (destructive, needs --yes)
8. `museoncli ugc feedback-thread +set-status --campaign-id <campaign-id> --creative-id <creative-id> --id <feedback-thread-id> --status open` (write): Resolve or reopen.

### Decide what counts (count, stop counting, split, merge, attribute posts)

`museoncli guide ugc-counting` · when: counting; not counted; stop counting; split post; merge videos; attribution; attach post; 计入; 不计入; 拆分; 合并视频; 归属

A post or video a payout already pays for refuses every counting change (post_in_payout); tell the user, do not work around it.

1. `museoncli campaign video +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): --status not-counted or confirmation to see the buckets.
2. `museoncli ugc creative +set-counting --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <creative-id> --counted` (write): --counted / --no-counted on an approved video; the creator is not told.
3. `museoncli ugc post +stop-counting --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <ids>` (destructive, needs --yes): Up to 100 posts by content id.
4. `museoncli ugc post +split --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <post-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): One confirmed post becomes its own video under the same Format.
5. `museoncli ugc creative +merge --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <creative-id> --merged-creative-id <merged-creative-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): Up to 10 of the creator's videos into this one; the emptied ones are deleted.
6. `museoncli ugc task +run-action --id <task-id> --action <action>` (destructive, needs --yes): Attribution tasks: attach / attach-unpaid / detach / skip, --fields-json {"creative_id": ...}.

### Generate, review and send client reports

`museoncli guide ugc-client-reports` · when: client report; daily report; weekly report; send report; report settings; 客户报告; 日报; 周报; 发报告

A report goes draft → request review → approve → send, or skip. Editing an approved report needs approving again.

1. `museoncli ugc client-report-config +get --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Which reports run, the groups they go to, schedule, language.
2. `museoncli ugc client-report-config +update --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write): --enable/--disable daily|weekly, times, groups; the dry run lists valid groups.
3. `museoncli ugc client-report +create --campaign-id <campaign-id> --type daily --date 2026-10-01` (write): --type daily|weekly|monthly|wrap-up --date: the report of the period holding it. Nothing is sent.
4. `museoncli ugc client-report +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)
5. `museoncli ugc client-report +get --campaign-id <campaign-id> --report-id <report-id>` (read): --report-id (or --id).
6. `museoncli ugc client-report +refresh --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <client-report-id>` (write): New figures, same text.
7. `museoncli ugc client-report +regenerate --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <client-report-id>` (write): Redraft from current data, replacing the text.
8. `museoncli ugc client-report +update --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <client-report-id>` (write): Edit title or Markdown with --expected-revision.
9. `museoncli ugc client-report +request-review --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <client-report-id>` (write, needs --yes): Posts to the internal Feishu group.
10. `museoncli ugc client-report +approve --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <client-report-id>` (write): Nothing is sent yet.
11. `museoncli ugc client-report +send --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <client-report-id>` (write, needs --yes): To the client's group, or --test to your own Mel chat.
12. `museoncli ugc client-report +skip --campaign-id <campaign-id> --id <client-report-id> --reason <reason>` (write): Not sent this period, with --reason.

### Look up the organization's creators

`museoncli guide ugc-creator-directory` · when: creator directory; find creator; creator profile; 达人库; 找达人; 达人资料

1. `museoncli ugc creator +list` (read): Across the organization's Campaigns; --search.
2. `museoncli ugc creator +get --id <creator-id>` (read): Profile, accounts and Campaigns of one person (UGC creator id).
3. `museoncli ugc enrollment +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Their enrollment in one Campaign: --creator-id <ugc creator> --detail for contract and Discord state.

See: `creator-ids`

### Find creators for a new project (MuseOn staff)

`museoncli guide ugc-creator-sourcing` · when: creator sourcing; source creators; find creators for a project; creator forms; creator works; form answers; 创作者寻源; 找创作者; 报名表; 大群注册表; 表单回答; 作品

MuseOn staff only, as the Creator Sourcing page; the team's notes are edited in the web.

1. `museoncli ugc sourcing +questions` (read): The form questions people answered and each choice's count: the labels and values for --answer.
2. `museoncli ugc sourcing +list` (read): Everyone who joined the community or applied, with their latest form answers; filter by country, language, topic, platform, views, --answer 'QUESTION::VALUE'; --search also matches answers; --sort avg-views.
3. `museoncli ugc sourcing +forms --id <sourcing-id>` (read): Every form one person filled in: the community registration and each project application.
4. `museoncli ugc sourcing +works --id <sourcing-id>` (read): Their newest works in our projects with views, stills and media links.

See: `creator-ids`

### Read settlement, payouts and payments (reads only)

`museoncli guide ugc-settlement-reads` · when: settlement; payout; payments; how much to pay; 结算; 打款; 付款; 支付

The CLI only reads money. Settling and paying stay in the web.

1. `museoncli campaign settlement +get --campaign-id <campaign-id> --date-from 2026-10-01 --date-to 2026-10-01` (read): A period's settlement per creator, or one creator's lines with --creator-id (UGC creator).
2. `museoncli campaign payout +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Settled payouts and their lines.
3. `museoncli campaign payment +list` (read): The organization's creator payments (operating organization's team).
4. `museoncli campaign payment-summary +get` (read)

## 2. Track content (content tracking Campaigns)

A content tracking Campaign follows creators' and posts' performance without applications or review. Create it, add the creators and posts to track, read the numbers. Everything after creation takes the Campaign id (`data.campaign.id` of `campaign +create`, or `campaign +list --type tracking`) as --campaign-id.

See: `ids`, `campaign-kinds`

### Create a tracking Campaign and add creators or posts

`museoncli guide tracking-create` · when: tracking campaign; track creators; track posts; monitor; add creators; add posts; 追踪; 监测; 添加达人; 添加帖子; 监控

1. `museoncli campaign +create --name <name>` (write): --type tracking.
2. `museoncli campaign creator +add --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write): --url imports new creators by profile URL in the background (data.url_import_task); --creator-id attaches known social accounts. --wait reports each URL's outcome.
3. `museoncli campaign content +add --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (write): --url imports posts by URL; --content-id attaches known ones. --wait reports each URL's outcome.
4. `museoncli campaign import +get --id <task-id>` (read): An add is queued, not done: --id is its task id; failures list each URL it could not read.
5. `museoncli campaign creator +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): data.items, the same shape for either kind of Campaign.
6. `museoncli campaign content +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)

### Stop tracking creators or posts

`museoncli guide tracking-remove` · when: remove creator; remove post; stop tracking; 删除追踪; 移除帖子; 移除达人

Removing only changes the Campaign; the platform account or post is untouched.

1. `museoncli campaign creator +remove --campaign-id <campaign-id> --creator-id <creator-social-account-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): --creator-id is the social account id; also drops its derived posts.
2. `museoncli campaign content +remove --campaign-id <campaign-id> --collection-content-id <collection-content-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): --collection-content-id, not the content id.
3. `museoncli campaign content +bulk-remove --campaign-id <campaign-id> --collection-content-ids <collection-content-id>` (destructive, needs --yes)

### Read a tracking Campaign's performance

`museoncli guide tracking-performance` · when: tracking performance; views; daily trend; breakdown; by creator tag; source video; 追踪数据; 播放量; 趋势; 分组

1. `museoncli campaign +get-summary --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Daily totals in --timezone; observed deltas are snapshot sums, not platform plays per day.
2. `museoncli campaign +get-period-performance --campaign-id <campaign-id> --period-start 2026-10-01 --period-end 2026-10-01` (read): Current period vs the one before.
3. `museoncli campaign +list-dimensions --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): What it can be broken down by.
4. `museoncli campaign +get-breakdown --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): --by creator-tag or source-video for tracking Campaigns.
5. `museoncli campaign content +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): The posts behind a number, same window and timezone.
6. `museoncli campaign creator-tag +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read)

### Read one account's or one post's synced history

`museoncli guide account-and-post-history` · when: creator history; account history; post performance; post history; resolve post; 账号历史; 帖子数据; 单帖

This is Museon's synced store, not a live platform fetch.

1. `museoncli campaign creator +get --creator-id <social-account-id>` (read): --creator-id is the social account id.
2. `museoncli campaign post +list --creator-id <social-account-id>` (read): --creator-id is the social account id.
3. `museoncli campaign creator +get-performance --creator-id <social-account-id> --date-from 2026-10-01 --date-to 2026-10-01` (read): --date-from and --date-to both required, at most 180 days.
4. `museoncli campaign post +get --content-id <content-id>` (read): --content-id is the post's content_id.
5. `museoncli campaign post +get-performance --content-id <content-id>` (read)
6. `museoncli campaign post +resolve --schedule-item-id <schedule-item-id>` (read): A publish schedule item → the post it became.

See: `creator-ids`

## 3. Read Campaign analytics and boards

The web Campaign Dashboard, tab by tab, keyed by the Campaign id; breakdowns by Format, persona and tag; the organization's analytics; multi-Campaign boards. Say which window, timezone and post scope (approved or all) every number uses.

See: `ids`, `organizations`

### Read a UGC Campaign's Dashboard

`museoncli guide dashboard` · when: dashboard; campaign performance; kpi; content tab; videos; creators tab; audience; 看板; 活动数据; 数据; 视频列表; 受众

1. `museoncli campaign +get --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Header: type, status, start day.
2. `museoncli campaign +get-summary --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): KPI tiles and trend.
3. `museoncli campaign +get-period-performance --campaign-id <campaign-id> --period-start 2026-10-01 --period-end 2026-10-01` (read): Analytics tab: this period vs the previous one.
4. `museoncli campaign report +get --campaign-id <campaign-id> --widget cumulative-views --date-from 2026-10-01 --date-to 2026-10-01` (read): --widget cumulative-views|content-tiers|creator-countries.
5. `museoncli campaign video +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Content tab; --scope approved reads confirmed posts only.
6. `museoncli campaign video +get --campaign-id <campaign-id> --content-id <content-id>` (read): --content-id from video +list; --section detail|summary|daily|insights.
7. `museoncli campaign roster +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): By Creator tab.
8. `museoncli campaign format +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Performance by Format; --date-from and --date-to, or --all-time.
9. `museoncli campaign format-post +list --campaign-id <campaign-id> --brief-id <brief-id>` (read): The posts behind one Format, same window.
10. `museoncli campaign audience +get --campaign-id <campaign-id> --date-from 2026-10-01 --date-to 2026-10-01` (read): --by period for the map and profile (owning organization only).
11. `museoncli campaign activity +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Activity log (owning organization only).

### Compare Formats, personas or tags

`museoncli guide breakdown` · when: which format performs best; breakdown; compare briefs; persona comparison; tag comparison; 哪个脚本好; 对比; 分组对比; 人设对比

Report the unassigned and awaiting-review buckets before any per-brief number; compare on median views with the post count beside it.

1. `museoncli campaign +list-dimensions --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): campaign_type decides what it offers; post_scopes says which scopes exist.
2. `museoncli campaign +get-breakdown --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): --by brief|persona|tag (UGC); --link-status linked reads approved posts only.
3. `museoncli campaign content +list --campaign-id <campaign-id>` (read): Drill into a row: --brief-id / --persona-id with the same window.

### Read the organization's analytics over all Campaigns

`museoncli guide org-analytics` · when: all campaigns; organization analytics; agency analytics; overall performance; delivery progress; 全部活动; 整体数据; 交付进度

1. `museoncli campaign +list` (read): --with-progress: each Campaign's delivery progress.
2. `museoncli campaign analytics +get` (read): Views, engagement, creators, posts and spend (operating organization only); --date-from and --date-to, or --all-time.

### Build and read analytics boards

`museoncli guide boards` · when: board; analytics board; multi campaign board; 看板; 分析看板; 多活动

1. `museoncli analytics board +list` (read)
2. `museoncli analytics board +get --id <board-id>` (read): Its Campaigns and saved filters.
3. `museoncli analytics board +get-data --id <board-id>` (read): --widget trends|core-metrics|content|creators; uses saved filters unless flags override; core-metrics needs a period.
4. `museoncli analytics board +create --name <name> --campaign-id <campaign-id> --campaign-type tracking` (write): 1 to 10 Campaigns of one --campaign-type (mixed for UGC and tracking together).
5. `museoncli analytics board +update --id <board-id>` (write): Name and opening filters; filters not passed keep their value.
6. `museoncli analytics board +set-source --id <board-id> --campaign-id <campaign-id> --campaign-type tracking` (write): Replace the Campaigns it reads.
7. `museoncli analytics board +delete --id <board-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): The share link ends with it. The share link itself is managed only in the web.

## 4. Manage social accounts, publishing and cloud phones

The organization's own social accounts: connect, tag, read performance, edit profiles, publish videos and photo sets, and run the cloud phones and IPs behind them.

See: `safe-writes`, `organizations`

### Find the organization's social accounts

`museoncli guide accounts-list` · when: accounts; social accounts; list accounts; find account; 账号; 账号列表; 找账号

1. `museoncli social-account +list` (read): Repeat --search-term for several handles in one call; --tag filters.
2. `museoncli social-account +get --id <account-id>` (read)
3. `museoncli publish account +list` (read): The bound accounts it can publish to.

### Connect, sync or disconnect an account

`museoncli guide accounts-connect` · when: connect account; bind account; authorize account; sync account; unbind; disconnect; 绑定账号; 授权账号; 同步账号; 解绑

1. `museoncli social-account +create-connect-link --platform tiktok` (write): A self-authorization link the user opens; it is a request until resolved.
2. `museoncli social-account +get-connect-link --id <link-id>` (read): Read or wait for the authorization result.
3. `museoncli social-account +sync --profile-id <profile-id>` (write): --profile-id is the Late profile id, not a MuseOn UUID; safe to repeat.
4. `museoncli social-account +sync-all` (write): Only your landing workspace in this organization.
5. `museoncli social-account +unbind --account-id <account-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): --account-id is the bound-account row id; revokes the platform authorization. Its dry run reads nothing: confirm which account first.

### Tag accounts

`museoncli guide accounts-tags` · when: tag account; account tags; label; 标签; 打标签

1. `museoncli social-account tag +add --id <social-account-id> --tag <tags>` (write): No version check: a change made in between is overwritten.
2. `museoncli social-account tag +remove --id <social-account-id> --tag <tags>` (write)
3. `museoncli social-account tag +set --id <social-account-id> --tag <tags>` (write): Exactly this set; --clear empties.

### Read an account's live performance

`museoncli guide accounts-performance` · when: account performance; followers; account stats; 账号数据; 粉丝; 账号表现

1. `museoncli social-account +get-performance --id <account-id>` (read): Authorized channels first, public fallback otherwise; say which source the numbers came from.

### Edit TikTok profiles and avatars

`museoncli guide accounts-profile` · when: profile edit; bio; display name; avatar; 改简介; 改头像; 改昵称; 主页

1. `museoncli social-account +draft-profile-edit --id <account-id> --prompt <prompt> --args-file input.json` (read): Drafts only; nothing changes.
2. `museoncli social-account +submit-profile-edit --id <account-id> --args-file input.json` (write)
3. `museoncli social-account +bulk-submit-profile-edit --account-updates <account-updates>` (write): Many accounts, one task.
4. `museoncli social-account +get-profile-edit --id <task-id>` (read): The only proof it was applied.
5. `museoncli social-account +bulk-generate-avatars --id <account-id> --prompt <prompt>` (read): Async; drafts per account.
6. `museoncli social-account +get-avatar-generation --id <task-id>` (read)

### Publish or schedule videos and photo sets

`museoncli guide publish-posts` · when: publish; post video; schedule post; upload video to tiktok; photo set; cancel publish; posted manually; 发布; 发视频; 定时发布; 图文; 取消发布

1. `museoncli publish account +list` (read): Pick account ids; --device-kind cloud-phone|real-device.
2. `museoncli publish post +schedule --idempotency-key <stable-key> --args-file input.json` (write): Up to 100 posts, up to 7 days ahead, scheduled_at with a timezone offset or now=true; keep the idempotency key and files unchanged on retry.
3. `museoncli publish job +list` (read): --task-id: the batch's jobs.
4. `museoncli publish job +get --id <job-id>` (read): delivery.stage says where the post stands; accepted is not published.
5. `museoncli publish job +cancel --id <job-id>` (write): Not yet published and scheduled no more than an hour ago.
6. `museoncli publish job +verify-manual --id <job-id>` (write): Staff, after posting a failed job by hand: pass --posted-at (and --post-url when known); it only verifies, never republishes.

### Drive an account's cloud phone

`museoncli guide cloud-phone-session` · when: adb; cloud phone; connect phone; stream; phone screen; totp; 2fa; login credentials; 云手机; 连手机; 投屏; 验证码; 账号密码

1. `museoncli social-account +connect-adb --id <account-id>` (write): Waits up to two minutes for a cold phone; on CLOUD_PHONE_BOOTING run it once more.
2. `museoncli social-account +renew-phone-lease --id <account-id>` (write): The relay renews every minute while ADB traffic flows.
3. `museoncli social-account +get-stream-url --id <account-id>` (read)
4. `museoncli social-account credentials +totp-code --id <account-id>` (read): Staff: generate a live 6-digit 2FA code without exposing passwords or permanent TOTP seeds.
5. `museoncli social-account credentials +get --id <account-id>` (read): Staff: reveal resolved login password, shared mailbox/Google SSO, FB parent inheritance, and live 6-digit TOTP code (permanent seed omitted unless --include-totp-secret).
6. `museoncli social-account credentials +bulk-status --id <account-id>` (read): Staff: inspect non-secret credential coverage and login types for up to 200 accounts.
7. `museoncli social-account credentials +bulk-totp-codes --id <account-id>` (read): Staff: generate live 6-digit 2FA codes for up to 50 accounts without passwords or seeds.
8. `museoncli social-account credentials +bulk-get --id <account-id> --reason <reason>` (read): Staff: reveal resolved login credentials for up to 20 accounts (--reason required; seeds omitted unless --include-totp-secret).
9. `museoncli social-account credentials +bulk-upsert --args-file input.json` (write): Staff: batch-encrypt up to 200 credential rows from --file (.csv/.json) or --args-json; preview with --dry-run.

### Read the phone fleet and fix phones' IPs

`museoncli guide cloud-phone-fleet` · when: fleet; phones; phone health; ip health; attention; set proxy; 手机列表; 设备; 换ip; 代理

1. `museoncli cloud-phone fleet +get` (read): Timestamps and stale say how fresh it is.
2. `museoncli cloud-phone summary +get` (read)
3. `museoncli cloud-phone attention +list` (read): What needs attention: down IPs, failed changes, reclaimable phones.
4. `museoncli cloud-phone phone +list` (read)
5. `museoncli cloud-phone phone +get --id <phone-id>` (read)
6. `museoncli cloud-phone phone +set-proxy` (write, needs --yes): Explicit IPs for up to 10 phones, at most 5 phones per IP; read-back verifies.

### Check and upgrade apps on phones

`museoncli guide cloud-phone-apps` · when: app version; upgrade tiktok; upgrade apps; app upgrade; 升级app; 应用版本

1. `museoncli cloud-phone app +list` (read): Installed and pinned versions, live from up to 50 phones.
2. `museoncli cloud-phone app-upgrade +preview --app youtube` (read): Which phones would move; changes nothing.
3. `museoncli cloud-phone app-upgrade +create --app youtube --idempotency-key <stable-key>` (write, needs --yes): Background job with an idempotency key.

### Manage IPs, IP groups and suppliers

`museoncli guide cloud-phone-proxies` · when: proxy; ip; add ips; check ips; ip group; supplier; 代理ip; ip分组; 供应商

1. `museoncli cloud-phone proxy +list` (read)
2. `museoncli cloud-phone proxy +get --id <proxy-id>` (read): One IP and every phone on it.
3. `museoncli cloud-phone proxy +add` (write): Up to 5000 from entries or a JSON/CSV file; new IPs are checked.
4. `museoncli cloud-phone proxy +check --id <proxy-id>` (write): Accepted is not healthy; inspect each result (--wait for fresh checks).
5. `museoncli cloud-phone proxy +move --id <proxy-id> --group-id <group-id>` (write)
6. `museoncli cloud-phone proxy +delete --id <proxy-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): Unused IPs only.
7. `museoncli cloud-phone proxy +export-credentials --id <proxy-id> --output <output>` (read, needs --yes): To a new mode-0600 file; never print the password.
8. `museoncli cloud-phone group +list` (read)
9. `museoncli cloud-phone group +create --name <name>` (write)
10. `museoncli cloud-phone group +delete --id <group-id>` (destructive, needs --yes): Empty groups only.
11. `museoncli cloud-phone supplier +list` (read)
12. `museoncli cloud-phone supplier +create --name <name>` (write): Password from --password-file.
13. `museoncli cloud-phone supplier +update --id <supplier-id> --name <name>` (write)
14. `museoncli cloud-phone supplier +delete --id <supplier-id>` (destructive, needs --yes)
15. `museoncli cloud-phone supplier +export-credentials --id <supplier-id> --output <output>` (read, needs --yes)

### Reclaim devices of disabled accounts

`museoncli guide cloud-phone-recovery` · when: recovery; reclaim phone; disabled accounts; 回收设备; 回收手机; 封号

1. `museoncli cloud-phone recovery +preview --account-ids <account-id>` (read): Live inspection; pick devices from it.
2. `museoncli cloud-phone recovery-job +create --account-ids <account-id> --device-ids <device-id> --idempotency-key <stable-key>` (destructive, needs --yes): Only devices from a fresh preview; retry with the same key.

4. `museoncli cloud-phone recovery-job +get --id <recovery-job-id>` (read): Every device's outcome and blockers.

6. `museoncli cloud-phone recovery-job +export --output <output>` (read): To a new local CSV file.

## Topics

### Which id goes where

- A Campaign has one id, whichever kind it is (UGC or tracking): the `id` of `museoncli campaign +list`. Every command that addresses a Campaign takes it as `--campaign-id`: `campaign`, `ugc` and `analytics board` alike.
- Inside a Campaign, `--id` is the entity the command acts on and the Campaign is `--campaign-id`: `ugc enrollment +approve --campaign-id <campaign> --id <enrollment>`, `ugc assignment +withdraw --campaign-id <campaign> --id <assignment>`. Other children are qualified (`campaign content +remove --collection-content-id`, `campaign video +get --content-id`).
- An enrollment id (`ugc enrollment +list`) is one creator's place in one Campaign: approve, message, nudge, persona and payscale take it. A creative id is one video (`ugc creative +list`, `campaign video +list`); a content id is one post on one platform; a collection-content id is one post's place in one Campaign (`campaign content +list`).
- A task id comes from `ugc task +list`; its `actions` list what `ugc task +run-action --action` accepts.
- Every id is a UUID; the CLI rejects placeholders before any request.

### The three creator ids

- **UGC creator** (a person, `ugc_creator_id`): `ugc creator +list`/`+get --id`; `campaign content +list --ugc-creator-id`; `--creator-id` on `campaign video +list`, `campaign settlement +get` and `ugc enrollment +list`.
- **Social account** (one handle on one platform, `creator_social_account_id` from `campaign creator +list`): `--creator-id` on every `campaign creator` command (`+get`, `+get-performance`, `+add`, `+remove`), `campaign post +list` and `campaign content +list`. A post on its own is `--content-id` (`campaign post +get`, `+get-performance`); the old `--id` on those reads still answers with a deprecation warning. A social account's `creator_info.creator_id` is unrelated: never read the person from it or from a handle.
- **Enrollment** (the person in one Campaign): what every `ugc enrollment`/`message` write takes.
- The same flag name `--creator-id` means a person on some commands and a social account on others: read the flag's help (`<command> --help`) before passing it.

### The kinds of campaign

- **UGC Campaign** (`campaign +create --type ugc`): creators apply, sign a contract, post against Formats (脚本, `brief` in commands) and are paid by payscales. Run by the operating team's organization; its creator work is `ugc`.
- **Content tracking Campaign** (`campaign +create --type tracking`): no applications or review; you add creators and posts (`campaign creator +add`, `campaign content +add`) and read their performance.
- Both kinds are listed, created, launched, set up and read the same way, with `campaign` (`campaign +list --type ugc|tracking`).
- **Agentic Creative Campaign** (`agentic-campaign`): MuseOn keeps publishing AI image posts on chosen accounts by persona Plans. Separate ids, its own lifecycle.
- HireAICreator plans and test groups (`hireaicreator`) are a separate product with their own Skill.

### Dry run, --yes and confirmation_required

- Every write takes `--dry-run`. On `ugc` and most newer commands the dry run reads the live state and shows what would change; elsewhere it validates and echoes the input. Nothing is written.
- A command that reaches someone outside the organization (messages, nudges, invitations, broadcasts, client reports, review verdicts) or cannot be undone needs `--yes`. Without it the CLI answers `ok: false, reason: confirmation_required` (exit 1) and, where it can, `preview`. Show the user the preview, ask, and only then rerun the same command with `--yes`. Never add `--yes` on your own.
- Plain writes (claim, comment, due date, persona, counting, settings) run without `--yes`; still dry-run first unless the user already decided exactly this change.
- `museoncli guide <task>` marks each step `read`, `write` or `destructive`, and `needs_yes`.

### Conflicts, retries and async work

- Compare-and-set: many writes send the version, status or `updated_at` they read (`--expected-version`, `--expected-status`, `--expected-updated-at`). A `conflict` means someone changed it since: read again, show the user, ask again. Never retry blindly.
- Idempotency: creates, messages and batch jobs return or take an `--idempotency-key`. After a timeout or unknown outcome, rerun with the same key and the same input; a new key does it twice.
- Async work returns a handle (task id, job id, batch id) and a matching `+get` command. A receipt is not completion: read the status until it is terminal, and use the returned wakeup delay instead of inventing one.
- A write is done only when its read-back says so (`+list`/`+get` of the same object).

### Organizations, roles and who may do what

- Every command acts in the selected organization (`museoncli org current`; change it with `museoncli org select --id <organization-id>`). `--organization-id <id>` addresses another organization for one call. Envelopes name it in `organization`.
- There is no workspace: no `workspace` command, no `--workspace-id`, except in `agentic-campaign` and `hireaicreator`.
- Your role in the organization (owner, admin, operator, member) and its Campaign scope decide what you see and change. UGC operations (approve, message, review, setup, client reports) belong to the Campaign's operating team: owner, admin, or an operator on that Campaign. A member reads.
- The server decides. A refusal is `not_found` or `forbidden`: tell the user this login cannot do it; never retry under another identity or organization.

### When a command fails

- Branch on `error.code` (same as `reason`), `error.server_code` and `error.retryable`; `error.hint` names the help to read on a usage error.
- `missing_auth` / `unauthorized`: run `museoncli auth start`, show the link, `museoncli auth finish --wait`, then resume. `missing_organization`: `museoncli org list`, `museoncli org select`.
- Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failure, 2 usage, 3 not found, 4 authentication, 5 conflict.
- A read that lists pages: add `--all` and check `page_info.complete`, or follow `next_cursor` with `--cursor`.

### Which of two similar commands to use

| Need | Use | Not | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| A UGC Campaign's roster to act on (approve, assign, message, persona) | `museoncli ugc enrollment +list` | `museoncli campaign roster +list` | ugc enrollment +list returns the enrollment ids ugc writes take (--detail adds contract and Discord state); campaign roster +list is the By Creator tab's figures. |
| Creators of a UGC Campaign with their post figures | `museoncli campaign roster +list` | `museoncli ugc enrollment +list`, `museoncli campaign creator +list` | roster +list is the By Creator tab; campaign creator +list lists the social accounts a Campaign covers, the tracking Campaign view. |
| One creator (a person) and their Campaigns | `museoncli ugc creator +get` | `museoncli campaign creator +get` | campaign creator +get reads one social account by its social account id. |
| A UGC Campaign's videos and their review state | `museoncli campaign video +list` | `museoncli campaign content +list`, `museoncli ugc creative +list` | video +list is the Content tab (each video once); campaign content +list lists every post with attribution and is the one for tracking Campaigns; ugc creative +list is the brief view for assigning Formats. |
| Approve or reject an application | `museoncli ugc enrollment +approve` | `museoncli ugc task +run-action` | Same effect. Working from the Tasks queue, press the task's own approve/reject with task +run-action; otherwise use enrollment +approve/+reject. |
| Approve or reject a video | `museoncli ugc creative +review` | `museoncli ugc task +run-action` | Same effect; from a review task use task +run-action --action approve\|reject. |
| Write to one creator | `museoncli ugc message +send` | `museoncli ugc broadcast +create`, `museoncli ugc enrollment +nudge` | A broadcast goes to many on Discord; a nudge is the fixed reminder for one check. |
| Daily trend and KPI tiles | `museoncli campaign +get-summary` | `museoncli campaign +get-period-performance` | +get-period-performance compares a period with the one before it. |
| Figures over several Campaigns | `museoncli analytics board +get-data` | `museoncli campaign analytics +get` | A board reads the Campaigns it holds; campaign analytics +get is every UGC Campaign of the operating organization. |
| Publish ready video files or photo sets | `museoncli publish post +schedule` | `museoncli ai-slideshow publish +create-schedule`, `museoncli hireaicreator delivery +share` | ai-slideshow publish schedules slideshow accounts; hireaicreator delivery shares HireAICreator videos. |
| A UGC Format (脚本) | `museoncli ugc brief +list` | `museoncli ai-slideshow asset +list`, `museoncli hireaicreator format +list` | ai-slideshow asset --type format and hireaicreator format are different products' formats. |
| A UGC persona (creator type) | `museoncli ugc persona +list` | `museoncli ai-slideshow asset +list`, `museoncli hireaicreator persona +list` | ai-slideshow asset --type persona is a slideshow voice; hireaicreator persona an AI creator. |
| Generate one image or video from a prompt | `museoncli media +generate` | `museoncli ai-slideshow generation +create` | ai-slideshow generation +create builds an image post from format, topic and persona assets. |

## Not in this guide

- `hireaicreator.*`: HireAICreator (AI creators, video plans, test groups, warmup, delivery) has its own workflow; follow the museon-content-workflow-hireaicreator Skill and `museoncli schema hireaicreator`.
- `staff-ops.*`: MuseOn staff diagnostics (deployed code, logs, read-only tables); not for customer work.
